rows.en: Go… what time do you think it is?
I'm sorry… I'll be more careful from now on!

This operation is a battle mankind cannot afford to lose!

You're not taking it seriously enough!
Yes, sir! Heading out!!
This is it… Looks like the TDF is launching an all-out attack on the Space Fortress Naager!
Apparently they're even prepared to launch a long-range missile strike with the TDF's entire strength!

Unfortunately…

an attack on that scale won't sink that ship…

What makes the Space Fortress Naager so terrifying is its incredible durability.

They're probably letting us throw every attack we have at them, and by weathering it all, they mean to show off the overwhelming gap in power between us.

Then… you're saying the TDF's attack won't even scratch it?

Damn it! If the enemy's up in space… there's nothing we can do! Are we just supposed to sit back and watch!?

Hello, Amigo…

Hello?

What? Taki, is that you? What's going on, calling me on the phone…? Now that's a rare thing!
What…!?
What's that supposed to mean…!?
Oyassan, what's wrong?

Well… I can hardly believe it myself, but…

he says outer space has appeared right in the middle of Tokyo!
Outer space…? Seriously???
Hey! [HERO2]! Where are you going? Hey!!
Hongo!
Right! Let's go after them!
Heh heh heh… I've been waiting for you! Lucifard!!
Atefarina! You opened the Dimensional Distortion Field, didn't you?

Maybe foolish humans like you can't understand what's happening here…!

But, you know… I thought I'd teach you a thing or two. Just what the power of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager is like. And what a Dimensional Distortion Field really is…
What!?

Heh heh heh… Give it your best shot, why don't you?

Our mothership, the impregnable Space Fortress Naager… Do you think you can stop it? Go ahead and try! Hah hah hah…!
Damn it…
Lucifard! I'll come back for you later… so wash your neck and wait!
Wait…!
So this is the Dimensional Distortion Field?
I can hardly believe it…
Arashi! You're representing our Science Patrol! Don't you dare embarrass us, got it?
Leave it to me, Cap! I'll take it down, I swear!
What on earth…! Outer space, right in the middle of the city…? What the hell happened here!?
No, no… This is a dream! We must be dreaming!
Captain…! What is all this?
Is Go fighting in there?

Looks that way.

Only… he launched for outer space, and yet here he is, smack in the middle of Tokyo! He must be confused too.
Is this the power of the Space Fortress Naager!? What kind of people are they!

Ah… Captain! The Space Fortress Naager is floating in the space area!

It appears to be moving slowly…!
Right! We have to stop its advance, whatever it takes!

Security Team, reporting in…!?

What…! What on earth is this?
Whatever it is… we must not let the Space Fortress Naager advance any further!
The invincible Red Baron can fight in space too! Let's go!

Heh heh heh…

See that? Our Naager has finally succeeded in opening a Dimensional Distortion Field on Earth!

Now… there's no one who can stop it!

Stop it! Atefarina!

Stop it, Ryoko!!

[HERO2]… You're the one who should come home to our Naager!

Soon the Space Fortress Naager will put down roots on Earth… And then we'll carry out the Gaia Project!

Once that happens… your life will be forfeit too!

Sis… tell me!

What is Father trying to do with the Gaia Project?

…………

We of the Naager are a clan that wanders the stars of the universe, trading in weapons we developed ourselves.

And now, the demand for them has spread across the entire universe…

This invasion of Earth will be our demonstration! And for that, the flashier, the better…

That is the Gaia Project!

Flashy…?

You mean to destroy the Earth in some flashy way? How, exactly?

…!?

Wait! Sis!!
Lucifard…
Apfaron…!?
I must admit, I'm surprised you've resisted this far…
Ryoma…

The Dimensional Distortion Field is open!

And the Space Fortress Naager is protected by its barrier. Thanks to Atefarina…

This impregnable fortress has no entrance, not even a single window. Do you really think you still have some way left to fight? What will you do next, little brother…
You already know without me saying it, don't you? That I'll never give up…

Heh heh heh… That's how you used to be.

But… in this situation, that sounds like nothing but a sore loser's bluster.

I don't care!

I'll share my fate with this Earth… and, more than anything, with these friends of mine!
Friends…?
Yeah… Someone like you wouldn't understand, brother!

Heh heh heh… Hah hah hah!!

How foolish, little brother… drowning in such worthless sentiment…

Very well. Rot away along with these so-called friends of yours!

But… if there's even a shred of the Naager spirit left in you… come back! Little brother…

Wait!

Like hell I'll come back! I'll beat you… I swear I'll beat you all!

I swear iiit!!
[HERO2]… the space area is gone!
Did they close it? The Dimensional Distortion Field…?
It looks that way…
In the end… we were powerless! We couldn't stop the Naager's advance!
Director! That space area seems to have vanished…
Director! We still have one arrow left to loose into space…

Hmm…

We will now begin the long-range missile strike!

Request cooperation from every TDF branch! Prepare for launch immediately!
Kuh…! Damn it!!
Kyaah…!
Stop the Space Fortress Naager's advance…!
[HERO2] or [HERO4] is defeated
<c3>Hideki Go</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!

Mari… it gets really cold up there at night!

You'd better bring a thick sweater you can sleep in too.

Heh heh… Thank you, Jiro. I'm an android, so I'll be fine.

But it'll be my first time seeing snow… so I'm really happy.
Me too, I'm so excited!
But Jiro might be right. I've heard the weather in the mountains changes easily…
But Jiro might be right. They say the weather in the mountains changes easily…
Yep, yep. Fickle as a woman's heart, like the winter mountains.
Oh, Jiro…

Hello…

Jiro's not being a bother, is he?
He's here, but it looks like he's not being a bother… so there!
Figured you'd be here. You're awfully excited, aren't you?

uncertain: U12907: speaker tag is [HERO2] but the line explains Naager's strategy; tone kept analytical.
U12909-U12911: one phone call split over three rows; the two narration rows are Tobei's continuation, written without speaker.
U12913: 'he says' refers to Taki (the caller), established in U12909.
U12936/U12959/U12963: 宇宙空間 here is the pocket of space opened in Tokyo; rendered 'the space area'.
U12942/U12944/U12950: 姉さん/兄さん are the hero's siblings; 'Sis' kept, 兄さん given as name 'Ryoma' or 'brother' depending on line.
U12976: pun on the proverb 女心と秋の空 (a woman's heart is as fickle as autumn skies) with winter mountains; rendered loosely.
U12979: Jiro answers Go's question about himself in mock third person; kept 'He's here… so there!'.

new_names.why: Atefarina's name as the hero's sister; not in glossary
Apfaron's name as the hero's brother; not in glossary
